payload.summary: Owner decision: register Lifeline, Suicide Call Back Service, 13YARN, Legal Yarn and TIS National as publishers in the source authority register
payload.detail: Their provider pages carry no publisher date and their publishers are absent from src/lib/source-authority-registry.ts, a protected RAG ranking surface, so their rows were omitted from src/data/source-acquisitions.json. Numbers are verified in src/lib/crisis-contacts.ts (verifiedOn) and in the part-08 service records. Registering changes retrieval selection: needs owner approval and the RAG ranking protection process.
